summary_md: **ScriptByAI ([@ScriptByAI](https://x.com/ScriptByAI/status/2115616662271705433))** reviews **Hob**, a free open-source desktop app that runs open-weight models like Gemma and gpt-oss locally on Mac, Windows and Linux, private and offline.

referenced_urls.title: Hob: Free Open-Source Local AI Assistant for Documents

relevance: A simple local-model front end; a baseline UX reference for local assistants.

media.description: Screenshot of the Hob desktop agent app: a chat asking for a chart of sales by region, steps 'Ran code', 'Ran code', 'Made a chart: Sales by Region (Q3)', and the resulting bar chart for East, North, South and West.
